title: Debug Notion MCP tool enumeration and cache behavior for reviewer hubs
description:
Debug the Notion-side MCP integration path for reviewer-specific Webflow template review hubs.

Current findings:
- Live reviewer hubs are healthy across all five reviewers and expose 14 proxy tools, including template_review_assign_self, template_review_unassign_self, template_review_my_queue, and template_review_get_review_context.
- The shared reviewer discovery pack does not restrict the surface to three tools. It sets mode=compact, activeServers=[webflow-template-review-mcp], maxProxyTools=18.
- The Hub does not sort before applying maxProxyTools; it preserves downstream registration order. However, simple local truncation does not explain Notion's exact three-tool list because the downstream tool registration order starts with template_review_health, template_review_get_metrics, template_review_list_queue, not template_review_get_field_map.
- The Notion bridge does not appear to implement its own tool filtering. It forwards auth/account/session context upstream. Missing session-token forwarding would not by itself explain a reduction to exactly three tools on compat reviewer hubs because fallback account context still yields allowedToolPrefixes=null (no per-route allowlist reduction).
- This points more strongly to a Notion client-side transformed/stale tool surface or a separate static allowlist path for agent summaries, rather than a reviewer hub deployment defect.
- Telemetry path identified: cs-telemetry-mcp query_activity filtered by correlationId or server/tool. Blocker: no CS_TELEMETRY_OPERATOR_API_TOKEN or HUB_OPERATOR_API_TOKEN is available in this workspace/Infisical context, so telemetry queries could not be executed from here.

Investigation plan:
1. Reproduce in Notion with a fresh session and capture exactly which tools the agent says are visible before and after 'retry Airtable tools'.
2. Compare tool surfaces for the same reviewer/account by querying the live reviewer hub directly with hub_list_proxy_tools and recording the returned proxy tools.
3. Determine what Notion is actually enumerating: MCP tools/list only, downstream proxy tools via Hub, or a transformed internal subset.
4. Test cache behavior by reconnecting or restarting the Notion agent session and checking whether the visible tool list changes without any server-side change.
5. Test refresh behavior by verifying whether 'retry Airtable tools' triggers a real discovery refresh or only a health/read call.
6. Check filtering logic and confirm whether Notion suppresses write-semantic tools such as template_review_assign_self and template_review_unassign_self.
7. Compare across reviewer hubs by running the same Notion-side check against at least Eric plus one other reviewer hub to rule out account-specific behavior.
8. If telemetry access is available, query cs-telemetry-mcp query_activity for recent hub_list_proxy_tools, hub_search_proxy_tools, and downstream template_review_* calls tied to the Notion session or correlation id.
9. Close with one explicit root-cause answer: stale cache, incomplete enumeration, transformed tool surface, write-tool filtering, or auth/session-scoped discovery mismatch.

Acceptance:
- explain why Notion showed only template_review_health, template_review_list_queue, and template_review_get_field_map while the live hubs exposed 14 proxy tools including self-assignment
- identify the responsible layer
- define the minimal fix or workaround

title: Investigate Notion MCP tool visibility mismatch for Webflow template review hubs
description: Notion agent attached to reviewer-specific Webflow template review hubs intermittently presented an incomplete downstream tool catalog and initially concluded that claiming/self-assignment was unsupported. Subsequent retest in Notion confirmed recovery: the agent explicitly identified webflow-template-review-mcp__template_review_assign_self and successfully claimed Healify version recWACpqub97KZasF for Eric Unger in Airtable. Live verification against all five reviewer hubs also remains healthy and consistent: each hub exposes the same 14 proxy tools and direct assign_self/get_review_context/unassign_self flows succeed. Current evidence suggests the primary remaining issue is not reviewer-hub capability but Notion-side agent behavior, likely due to missing or weak task-specific instructions and possibly transient session/discovery state. Secondary observability gap remains: Notion does not surface requestId or correlationId from Hub responses, which makes direct trace lookup harder. Keep this bug focused on intermittent tool visibility / agent guidance quality in Notion rather than missing claim support.

Use conservative keyword matching so obvious content-oriented packages default to content, obvious live-state/workflow packages default to operational, and everything else stays generic. Update help/docs and verify with temporary scaffold runs that omit --profile.

title: Draft concierge chat product plan and policy updates
description: Define package structure, route map, widget/rendering model, data flow, and policy updates for an AI-native concierge chat product with progressive profiling and dynamic in-chat tools.

title: Add profile-aware MCP scaffold docs
description: Extend create-mcp with explicit scaffold profiles so generated README.md and UNDERSTANDING.md content varies by MCP type. Start with generic, content, and operational profiles derived from existing package families. Update scaffold docs/help and verify by generating temporary MCP packages for at least two profiles.

title: Emit starter UNDERSTANDING.md from MCP scaffold
description: Add an UNDERSTANDING.md template to scripts/templates/mcp so create-mcp emits a starter package understanding document alongside README.md. Update create-mcp next steps and MCP_SCAFFOLD.md to mention replacing the generated understanding placeholders. Verify by generating a temporary MCP package and confirming UNDERSTANDING.md is created.

title: Emit starter README contracts from MCP scaffold
description: Add a README.md template to scripts/templates/mcp so create-mcp emits a starter Agent Legibility Contract with new MCP packages. Update scaffold docs and create-mcp next steps to tell operators to replace placeholder contract wording. Verify by generating a temporary MCP package and confirming the README is created.

title: Bake legibility metadata into package scaffolds and review checks
description: Update the MCP scaffold template and MCP_SCAFFOLD.md so new packages include createSomething.agentLegibilityContract by default. Extend scripts/agent-legibility-check.mjs to fail when a package README contains an Agent Legibility Contract section but package.json does not opt in, so review catches missing metadata. Verify with pnpm agent:legibility:check.

title: Draft client hub UX policy and DUI organization guidance
description: Define a client-hub user-experience policy and document where Dynamic UI / Generative UI for MCP should live in the codebase.

title: Derive agent legibility coverage from package metadata
description: Add an explicit package metadata flag for legibility-contract coverage, update the checker to discover target READMEs from package.json declarations instead of a hard-coded list, and widen CI triggers to package README/package.json changes. Verify with pnpm agent:legibility:check.

title: Broaden agent legibility contract coverage to additional package families
description: Add Agent Legibility Contract sections to create-something-mcp, substrate-mcp, and space READMEs. Widen scripts/agent-legibility-check.mjs and .github/workflows/agent-legibility-check.yml to enforce the expanded package set, then verify with pnpm agent:legibility:check.

title: Promote typechecked packages to explicit lint
description: Add package-local lint scripts to packages that already expose typecheck but still rely on workspace structural fallback, raising explicit lint coverage by archetype.

title: Draft internal assessment for mixed-stack client MCP offer
description: Produce an internal assessment that maps the Gemini/Composio client-hub brief onto current monorepo capabilities, packaging, gaps, and recommended delivery posture.

title: Add mechanical enforcement for agent legibility contract coverage
description: Add a mechanical check for Agent Legibility Contract coverage and wire it into the repo's root scripts. Start with the representative package docs that already adopted the contract, verify the check passes, and leave the target list easy to expand later.

title: Add explicit lint scripts to core agent packages
description: Promote core harness/control-plane packages from workspace structural lint fallback to explicit package-local lint scripts so agent workflows have deterministic lint entrypoints.

title: Apply agent legibility contract to representative packages
description: Apply the Agent Legibility Contract to a representative set of packages so the guide becomes real repo practice. Cover the harness, the harness MCP surface, one service-style MCP/Worker package, and one UI package with a preview path.

title: Migrate harness source from Beads-era task primitives to Loom-native terminology
description: Replace Beads-era type names, comments, and user-facing text in the harness source with Loom-native task terminology where behavior has already shifted. Keep behavior stable while aligning code concepts with the documented Codex/Loom operating model.

title: Implement real monorepo lint gate
description: Root pnpm lint currently only executes in packages/io because most workspaces lack a lint script. Add a workspace-aware lint gate so Codex/openai agent flows have a meaningful monorepo lint command.

title: Design recurring cleanup loops for docs, drift, and quality grades
description: Design recurring cleanup workflows that detect docs drift, architectural drift, and quality regressions early. Favor small, frequent cleanup PRs over periodic manual refactor sweeps.

title: Define an agent legibility contract for monorepo packages
description: Define a repo standard for package legibility to agents: boot command, smoke path, trace/log surface, UI validation path if relevant, and escalation behavior when validation fails.

title: Converge harness docs and flows on Codex/Loom-native execution
description: Remove transitional Beads-first assumptions from harness-facing docs and workflows where Loom/Codex is now the intended control plane. Define the default self-review, agent-review, and worktree execution loop in Codex-native terms.

title: Refactor AGENTS.md into a routing-first table of contents
description: Shorten AGENTS.md so it acts as a stable routing file, not a dense instruction blob. Add or improve docs indexes so agents can discover architecture, policy, plans, and quality artifacts through progressive disclosure.

title: Implement article follow-through: harness engineering implications
description: Track repository changes prompted by the 2026-03-09 OpenAI harness engineering review. Use docs/internal/OPENAI_HARNESS_ENGINEERING_IMPLICATIONS_2026-03-09.md as the decision memo and parent context for follow-up work.

title: Fix io/space Cloudflare Pages deploy path resolution
description: While reviewing footer parity on March 7, 2026, @create-something/io and @create-something/space built successfully from the workspace root, but deployment failed. package-local deploy scripts rebuild without resolving @create-something/canon/styles/components.css, and direct wrangler deploys from .svelte-kit/cloudflare fail because the generated worker manifest references ../output/server/* files that do not exist inside the deploy bundle. Confirm the correct SvelteKit/adapter-cloudflare deployment workflow and update deploy scripts so io and space can deploy non-interactively.

title: Fix .agency Pages build after stale/missing generated assets
description: While validating footer deployment parity on March 7, 2026, @create-something/agency build failed independently of footer code. First failure was a missing generated endpoint module under .svelte-kit/output/server/entries/endpoints/api/abundance/convert/_server.ts.js. After regenerating .svelte-kit, the build progressed but adapter-cloudflare then failed on ENOENT for packages/agency/.svelte-kit/output/client/Micah_Johnson_Cover_Letter_Tomo.pdf. Investigate generated asset references and ensure agency can build and deploy cleanly from a fresh checkout.

title: Seed Auth0 secrets into Infisical and Pages for .agency
description: Populate AUTH0_* secrets in Infisical at /agency/auth or chosen path, sync them to the create-something-agency Pages project, verify /login and /auth/callback in production, and then deploy the Auth0 pivot safely. Current blocker: Pages project has no AUTH0_* secrets and Auth0 CLI is not installed on this machine.

title: Ensure policy-os-engine builds before agency
description:
Agency builds can fail in a clean workspace because @create-something/policy-os-engine exports dist/index.js but is not guaranteed to be built before vite resolves it. Acceptance criteria:
- Reproduce from a clean workspace
- Fix build ordering or exports so pnpm --filter @create-something/agency build succeeds without a manual prebuild
- Verify the relevant workspace build path
